scope: Standalone package validation only; no ESP_LoRaLab integration or physical device access
build_environment_note: Initial deeply nested Windows dependency extraction hit the path-length limit. Successful builds used PLATFORMIO_LIBDEPS_DIR pointing to the existing pinned dependency cache and PLATFORMIO_BUILD_DIR pointing to a shorter temporary build directory. Source and pinned versions were unchanged.
tests_environment_note: Python tests used the existing Python runtime with installed pyserial available through PYTHONPATH. The package declares all dependencies for installation into its own .venv.
